name: gr1-tabletop-cuttingboard-pan-n1d7-noise01-extension-v1
question: Does K=4, noise=0.1 satisfy the frozen ODE/SDE equivalence gate after extending the reset-cluster panel from 16 to 32 seeds?

trigger.selection_reason: The prior rule extends the lowest-noise inconclusive condition, not the condition with the best observed point estimate.

extension_design.pairing: Each new ODE/SDE pair shares scenario, environment seed, policy seed, and initial latent plan. Prior and new rows are combined before inference.
extension_design.primary_interval: 10,000-sample paired cluster bootstrap over all 32 reset seeds

equivalence_gate.pass: Point estimate and reset-clustered 95% interval are wholly within [-0.10, 0.10].
equivalence_gate.reject: The clustered interval excludes the equivalence region on either side, or the absolute point estimate is at least 0.20.
equivalence_gate.inconclusive: Any result that is neither pass nor reject.

decision_rule.on_pass: Restart the one-task GRPO recipe from the unchanged SFT base with noise_level=0.1 as the only changed factor and evaluate through at least 20 updates.
decision_rule.on_reject: Do not optimize. Stop and review denoise-step calibration design.
decision_rule.on_inconclusive: Do not automatically spend more GPU. Stop and review the equivalence margin and power design before any extension.
